page_subtitle: The people who call your customers, and how new orders reach them
load_error: Could not load the confirmation team.

rule.title: How new orders are shared
rule.manual: By hand: new orders wait until a manager gives them to someone.
rule.in_turn: In turn: each member who is receiving gets the next order, one after the other.
rule.evenly: Evenly: the next order goes to whoever has the fewest orders waiting.
rule.take_back_off: Orders stay with their member until they act.
rule.take_back_on: An order left untouched for {minutes} min moves to the next member, up to {limit} times.
rule.nobody_receiving: Nobody is receiving new orders right now.
rule.receiving_now_one: {count} of {total} members is receiving new orders now.
rule.receiving_now_other: {count} of {total} members are receiving new orders now.

settings.title: How new orders are shared
settings.manual_help: New orders wait with nobody until a manager gives them out.
settings.in_turn_help: Each member who is receiving gets the next order, one after the other. Simple when everyone works at the same pace.
settings.evenly_help: The next order goes to whoever has the fewest orders still waiting. A quick member gets more, and nobody is buried.
settings.take_back_help: If a member doesn't act on a new order in time, it goes to the next member so the customer is called quickly. An order with a callback stays with its member.
settings.limit_help: After that, the order waits for a manager.

queue.former_one: {count} order is still with someone who left the team
queue.former_other: {count} orders are still with someone who left the team
queue.former_rule: They go back to the team by your rule as soon as someone is receiving.
queue.former_manual: Give them to someone on the team.
queue.unassigned_manual: Orders are shared by hand: give them to someone on the team.
queue.unassigned_nobody: Nobody is receiving new orders. Turn receiving on for a member below.
queue.needs_manager_hint: Nobody acted on them in time, again and again. Give them to someone who can call now.
queue.shared_none: Nobody could take them: no member is receiving.
queue.unassigned_auto: They go to the members who are receiving, a few at a time.

members.title: Members
members.empty_title: No one is on the team yet
members.empty_body: Add the people who call your customers to confirm orders. New orders then reach them by the rule you choose.
members.remove_empty: {name} will get no new orders. The orders they confirmed stay to their credit.
members.remove_rule_one: {name} will get no new orders. Their waiting order goes to the team by your rule.
members.remove_rule_other: {name} will get no new orders. Their {count} waiting orders go to the team by your rule.
members.remove_manual_one: {name} will get no new orders. Their waiting order will wait for you to give it to someone.
members.remove_manual_other: {name} will get no new orders. Their {count} waiting orders will wait for you to give them to someone.
members.warning_no_access: Sees no order yet: give them Orders › “Only their own”.
members.error: Could not change this member. Try again.
members.subtitle: Who calls your customers, and who is receiving new orders now

add.title: Add to the confirmation team
add.none_left: Everyone is already on the team. Invite more people on the Team page.
add.no_access: {name} sees no order yet. Once added, give them Orders › “Only their own” so they can work the orders they get.
add.receiving_help: They get new orders by your rule as soon as they're added. You can turn it off any time.

results.title: Results
results.rate_help: Out of the orders they confirmed or cancelled. Orders still waiting are left out.
results.delivery_help: Out of their confirmed orders whose delivery ended: delivered or come back.
results.speed_help: On average, the time from getting an order to their first decision on it.
results.explain: Orders placed in the period that are with each member now.
results.empty: No order placed in this period is with the team.

pay.title: Pay
pay.unpriced_one: {count} order has no rate for its day
pay.unpriced_other: {count} orders have no rate for their day
pay.explain: Each rate applies from its date, so a past month keeps the rates it had. A salary starts on the first of its month.
pay.error: Could not save the pay. Try again.
pay.remove_body: {kind}: {amount} from {date}. Months it applied to will be counted again without it.
pay.salary_starts: A salary starts on the first of its month: {date}.

me.error: Could not change it. Try again.

order.changed: This order changed hands meanwhile. Reload to see who has it.
